description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walgama North, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820013
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership and property rights rather than government personnel changes, organizational structures, or other specialized categories.
